description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade and check functions for certain embedded devices, including functions to verify image compatibility, perform upgrades, and copy configurations based on the device model.

methods.name: enable_image_metadata_check
methods.description: Enables image metadata verification on supported board models.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the firmware image is compatible with the current device based on its board name.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the system upgrade process tailored to specific device models.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies the system configuration for certain device types prior to upgrade.

methods.name: platform_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Pre-upgrade steps such as preparing SD card images on specific boards.
